source: Import mode — Farrice Cain Premium Minimal Portable Design System v0.9-review (_active/farrice-brand/premium-minimal/package/02-DESIGN-CONTRACT.md + tokens/design-tokens.json), approved visual parent P2-01 Premium Minimal V1; Performance Evidence Journal vertical mode per visual-workflow verdict 2026-08-31. Declared values, not measured; every declared value is locked.

display.style: the only face in the system — Helvetica Neue, sentence case, tight tracking, close optical leading

mono.note: No monospace in this system. Functional labels and field indices are uppercase Helvetica Neue 700 with +0.16em tracking.

fonts._source: system font on macOS (/System/Library/Fonts/HelveticaNeue.ttc); no webfont files shipped, no Google Fonts URL. Renderers fall back to Helvetica/Arial off-Mac.

colors._note: There is no accent hue. The one bold move per surface is the DARK RECOMMENDATION (ink field, paper text), so accent == ink on purpose. Never introduce a colored accent, route color, or warning color. The approved launch banner keeps legacy #F3F0EA / #151514 exactly; those are not system tokens.

labels: CREATIVE STRATEGY FOR SUPPLEMENT + PERFORMANCE BRANDS
masthead.style: functional masthead — small uppercase identity label, top-left; never a decorative logo

field_index.note: page numbers as a two-digit field index instead of dots

master_brand.descriptor: CREATIVE STRATEGY FOR SUPPLEMENT + PERFORMANCE BRANDS
master_brand.offer_reference: restrained footer or final frame only

offer.author: FARRICE CAIN
offer.route_grammar: only when genuine choices are compared

performance_evidence_journal.kind: vertical Health Performance mode inside Premium Minimal — not a parallel brand system (verdict 2026-08-31)
borrowed_grammar: mono-style evidence labels rendered in Helvetica caps (Integrated Biosciences ref)
rejected_directions: Peak State Cinema (dark full-bleed motion photography)
Private Performance House (linen, brushed metal, amber)

carousel_page.note: identical to feed image; all pages same size

portrait_policy.source: only the original supplied portrait pixels from the private identity add-on (Farrice supplies; none placed here)
portrait_policy.frequency: occasional authority or story device; not required on every asset

prohibited: warning colors, shields, checks, compliance theater
stock supplement imagery as generic credibility
stale approval labels on public assets
logos for the Decision Book, Angle Cards, or Build First Card
route lines as decoration when no choice is compared
